picks.title: The Onslaught Of Lazy Browser Ports Hit A Wall Thanks To New Update
picks.excerpt: Claude and OpenAI are clamping down on unauthorized decompilations and cyber abuse.
picks.rationale: This is a new event in the decomp/browser-port wave: the model vendors themselves (Anthropic, OpenAI) are restricting unauthorized decompilation. It directly changes which AI-assisted porting and modding workflows still work.

picks.title: Indie Game Dev Cancels Vibe-Coded Zombie Shooter After San Francisco Officials Condemn 'Dehumanizing' Game Set in City's Tenderloin Neighborhood
picks.excerpt: The developer of a zombie game set in San Francisco has removed the game from online marketplaces and issued a public apology after city officials condemned the title for depicting its homeless people as 'zombies.'
picks.rationale: A follow-up with a concrete new outcome: after city officials condemned the game, it was pulled from storefronts and the developer apologized. It shows how fast a vibe-coded release can turn into a real-world reputational and civic problem.

picks.title: "AI로 복제게임 만들어 유포하겠다" 인디 개발자에 협박
picks.excerpt: 일본 인디게임 개발자가 생성형 AI로 제작한 복제 게임을 먼저 출시하겠다며 금품을 요구하는 협박성 메일을 받았다. 개발자는 협박에 응하지 않고 불특정 개발자를 노린 사기성 메시지일 가능성을 제기했다. 최근 해외와 일본 인디게임계에서는 AI를 악용한 복제 게임 출시 우려가 확산되고 있다
picks.rationale: This is a distinct new incident: AI cloning used as an extortion threat against an indie developer, which is a step beyond the clone and demo-pulling stories already covered. The full gid=1781995 URL is not in history.

https://www.ign.com/articles/indie-game-.new_action: San Francisco officials formally condemned the game; the developer then removed it from online marketplaces and issued a public apology (takedown event after the 10-18 criticism story).
